tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// gnas chen tsa ri tra'i ngo mtshar snang ba pad dkar legs bshad ces bya ba bzhugs so// "$ (1ba2)༄༅// na mo gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī ye/ rnam bcas ma mo'i 'khor lo ris med la// rtag tu 'khyud pa mnyams bde mchog gi// sgyu 'phrul rgya mtsho mngon sum tsa ri trar// snang bas dad pa'i phyag kun de la bgyid// rgyal las mkhas pa gzhan med de gsang nyid// 'jig rten gsum gyi nyin byed yin pas su// rjes dpag rta bdun bzang por de drangs nas// cal sgrogs blo mun thams cad gzhom par 'dod// de yang*/ lho gnas mchog dpal gyi tsa ri zhes grags pa'i ngo mtshar gyis yid mgu nas/ dus tshogs padma can 'ongs dpal 'di zhes/ mkhas pa'i dad pa dpyad pas yid mgu nas/ snyan ngag gshog yangs dkar po rab brkyang ste/ ya mtshan bstod pa'i mgrin rnga dal gyis brdung*/ ji ltar na/ 'di nyid sku gsung thugs kyi zhing*/ rgyud sde nas gsungs pa/ de'i ngo mtshar gyi bkod pa/ gnas sgo phye tshul/ bskor bas sangs rgyas kyi lam rim par bgrod pa'i brdar mthong ba lngas so// dang po ni/ kun khyab kun tu brdzus kyang dang po'i tshul// nam yang 'gyur med gyur ba zad pa mtha'// rgyal rnams gzigs pa'i rtser 'thon nyid 'dis nyid/ dag pa chos sku'i zhing zhes ri mor byas/ dpal bde mchog 'khor lo nyid dang gnyis su byar med pa// gsang ba mchog gi dkyes pa na// thams cad bdag nyid rtag tu bzhugs// zhes pa'i pho brang chen po ni 'di ste/ chos thams cad la khyab pas/ chos can gyi ngo nas dmar sbyar yang*/ chos nyid kyi tshul nam yang 'gyur ba med pa sangs rgyas rnams kyi gzigs pas grub pa'i phyir ro// rgyu mtshan 'di nyid kyis nyid la gsang ba chos sku'i zhing khams zhes ri mor byas kyi/ gzhan gyi bsam pa dang brjod pa thams cad kyi ra ba 'gongs pas so// ngo bo de ltar yin pas/ gzhi gcig steng du ma lus dkyil 'khor che// zhi chags khro ba rnam pa'i (2

na 3)mchog thams cad// ston la rdul rer rdul snyed de 'dra'i tshul// 'char bas snang ba longs sku'i zhing yang 'di// ji ltar du mar snang zhe na/ gzhi gcig gi steng du rgyud sde rin po che rnams nas bshad pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha zhi ba dang*/ chags tshul dang*/ khro bo khrag 'thung chen po'i rnam pa thams cad ston pa'i zhing la khams gsum gyi yul ma yin pa'i 'og min stug po bkod pa zhes rnam par bzhag mod/ tshul de nyid kyis 'di'i rdul rer 'jig rten khams thams cad kyi rdul dang grangs mnyam pa'i gsang ba sngags kyi lha dang*/ snying po dang*/ phyag rgya thams cad 'char ba'i phyir na/ nang snang ba longs sku'i zhing khams su grub bo// des byed pa'i las/ mtha' ma 'bring dang mchog gi gang zag la/ ngo mtshar gang gis 'dul de'i chu zla'i gar/ pra babs mig la shel mtshungs 'dir snang bas/ sgyu 'phrul sprul pa'i yul gyi gtan tshigs mthong*/ skal ba dman 'bring mchog gi gang zag rang rang ngo mtshar du 'dzin pa/ ri/ mtsho/ lung pa/ ljon shing*/ srog chags/ lha'i gzugs brnyan/ lha tshogs sogs gang gis 'dul ba de dang der grub kyis/ gcig tu chad pa yin pa/ dper na pra babs pa la dpod mkhan gyi dbye bas/ mdun ngor shel gcig la mthong ba sna tshogs su 'gyur ba bzhin gyi phyi yul snang sprul pa sku'i zhing khams 'di shar ro// gnyis pa rgyud sde nas ji ltar gsungs pa ni/ dus 'khor rtsa rgyud du// gnas ni shar du lus 'phags dang*/ lho ru dzambhu gling dang ni/ nub tu nub kyi ba lang spyod/ byang du byang gi sgra mi snyan/ phyogs bral nye ba'i gling rnams ni// nye ba'i gnas gyur sa gzhi la'o// de bzhin zhing la sogs pa kun/ rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor sogs rnams la/ zhes pas/ gnas dang nye bar gnas/ zhing dang nye ba'i zhing*/ tshando dang nye ba'i tshando/ 'du ba (2ba4)dang nye ba */ 'phung gcod dang nye ba'i 'thung gcong*/

dur khrod dang nye ba'i dur khrod ste bcu gnyis sa dang*/ 'jig rten gyi khor yug phyi ma dag gi mthar thug par gnas pa dang*/ dur khrod chen po rnams nam mkha'i khams la ste/ dri med 'od du/ des na nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor la phyi rol du dur khrod rnams te/ de'i rnam par dag pas 'jig rten gyi khams kyang dpag tshad 'bum phrag lnga'o// zhes pa 'khor lo sdom pa chen po la'o zhes 'byung ba dang*/ yang rtsa rgyud de nyid du/ kā ma rū pa dzā lar grags sogs dzambū'i gling nyid la gnas la sogs de dag bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad du gsungs/ dgyes pa rdo rjer/ gnas ni dzā landha rar bshad sogs sum cu rtsa bdun/ bde mchog las/ ku lu ta dang dgon pa dang*/ siddhu'i yul dang grong khyer dang*/ gser gyi gling dang so so raṣṭa/ de bzhin khyim gyi lha dang ni/ ya dngas grong dang kha ba'i gnas/ kañtsi lamba ka yi yul/ ka liṅka dang ko sa la/ tri sha ku ni o ṭa dang*/ kā ma rū pa mā la wa/ lha mo mkhar dang rā me dbang*/ go dā wa ri a rpu ta/ u rgyan dzā landha ra dang*/ pū li ra ma la sogs pa zhes/ ku mu ta/ ma ru/ sindhu/ na ga ra/ lamba ka /sau raṣṭa/ kha ba can/ kañtsi/ mā la wa/ gṛ ha de wa/ ka liṅka/ ko sa la/ pre ta pu ri/ tri sha kuni/ pū la ri ma/ dzā landha ra/ o ṭa/ kā ma rū pa/ de wi ko ṭa/ rā me shwa ra/ go dā wa ri/ a rpu ta/ gser gling*/ u rgyan rnams te/ bshad rgyud las/ ming gzhan dang gzhan gyis gsungs so// de dag las 'dir/ ston pas sprul bshad mdzad de'i lho phyogs kyi/ dur khrod che 'di zhes pa/ sngon 'jig rten gyi khams 'di gnas pa'i bskal pa byung nas mi ring ba na/ lha dang*/ lha ma yin dang*/ gnod sbyin dang*/ srin po dang*/ klu/ mi'am ci'i dbang po dang dbang mo brgyad kyis gnas 'di dag bzung bas mkha' spyod dang*/ sa spyod dang*/ sa 'og tu spyod pa'i gnas zhes dang*/ dur khrod chen po brgyad du grags la/

de'i tshe drag po 'jigs byed dang*/ dus mtshan ma (3 na 5)khyo shug ming gzhan lha dbang phyug chen po dang*/ lha mo chen mo u ma gangs te se na pho brang bcas pa de 'jig rten gyi gtso bor mthong nas/ de dag gis de gnyis mchod la/ de gnyis 'khrig pa la dga' nas/ de dag gis bos sar 'gro mi khom pas/ rdo'i liṅga mgo bo lta bu la sogs pa nyi shu rtsa bzhi'am/ so gnyis de dag la byin/ de dag gis kyang de la mchod par byed do// des 'jig rten lam log pa la zhugs shing nyon mongs pa bdo pa 'dul ba'i dus la bab par gzigs te/ 'og min gyi zhing nas longs spyod rdzogs pa rgyu'i he ru ka des sprul pa'i he ru ka sku mdog sngon po zhal bzhi/ phyag bcu gnyis pa rang gis sprul pa'i phag mo dang lhan cig g.yas brkyang ba'i gar mdzad pa der bzhengs te/ ri rab kyi rtser byon pa la/ rigs lnga'i rgyal ba rnams kyis pho brang dang 'khor mchod pa'i lha mo sprul nas phul bas/ rigs bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor chen por grub pa der/ drag po 'jigs byed 'khor bcas longs spyod pa/ dbang du byed pa/ thim pa'i tshul gyis btul nas/ bde mchog rtsa ba'i rgyud chen po rig pa rgya mtsho gsungs pa'i dus de'i dkyil 'khor gyi lho phyogs dur khrod chen po brgyad kyi nang tshan de 'di yin pas/ phyogs skyong gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po yab yum yang 'dir pho brang bcas te/ deng sang de'u brag dmar zhes bya la/ de yang*/ rnying ma'i gshin rje dmar po'i rgyud las/ gshin rje'i zangs mkhar dmar po gru gsum rmangs 'og rim pa dgur sleb cing*/ steng mi yul las gyen du 'phags pa/ gshin lam ro khung nyam nga ba dang*/ gshin rje'i bla mtsho dang*/ gshin rje'i ro thang dmar po/ gshin sdong mi ro rengs pa lta bu la sogs pas bskor bar bshad pa de ga yin la/ bi ma las/ dag pa shel re'i byang du gshin rje'i 'du khang zhes dang*/

lam yig gzhan nas/ tsa ri lung chung zhes shin tu 'jigs pa'i gnas su bshad la/ rgyu mtshan des lho gnas mchog ces btags so// nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gya/ bla med rgyud gzhung rgya mtshos (3ba6)gnas mchog tu/ bsgrubs pas zhes pa/ dzambū'i gling gi yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi las/ 'di nye ba'i tshando hi ma la ya/ bod kyi skad du/ kha ba can nam/ gangs can/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud las/ bod kyi yul dang de bzhin du/ mā la wa dang pū li sogs/ nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i yul yin no// zhes pa'i bod de/ de yang*/ dag pa shel ri gtso bor byas nas gangs can zhing skyong gnas pa'i sa gtso bor byas nas bod du gsungs te/ don gcig la ming gi khyad par ro// zhing skyong brgyud der/ bod yul du ni lhan skyes te/ zhes lhan cig skyes ma/ ming gzhan g.yu'i sgron ma/ chu srin rgyal mtshan lag na thogs/ zhi zhing gsal ba'i gzugs can te/ zhes mngon rtogs/ yul der gnas pa'i lha mo de/ brag gi khyim la brten te gnas zhes/ 'gyur 'ga' zhig tu brag gi phug la brten te gnas zhes pas/ gnas sa'am rten cig car phu'i rdo'i snying phug dang*/ smyug ri smyug khang*/ bod yul der sngar drag po 'jigs byed khyo shug gis byin pa'i liṅga ji lta bu yod pa zhe na/ rang byung gi ni skye gnas byung zhes pas/ bod rdo mtshan can te/ rang byung gi skye gnas yul chen po de mi 'gyur ba'i mtshan ma'o// rgyud 'dir bod yul du bshad pa bzhin/ deng sang bod klungs zhes grags shing*/ spyir btang la bod dang bod chen por gdags gzhi 'di kho na'o// zhing skyong yab der/ longs spyod ces bya'i dpa' bo che/ kṣe ḍa pā la thub dka' 'o// zhes longs spyod thub dka' ste/ seng ge'i gdong pa can/ de gnas pa'i sa yang*/ rgyud der/ brag ri brtsegs pa dag la gnas/ zhes pas/ cig car phu'i dpal ri zlum can te/ dag pa shel ri'i gdong chen du bzhag pa de'o// gzhan yang rngam pa sgra sgrogs sogs la gnas pa nyid do// rgyud 'dir/

ka rañdza gnas tsa ri tra/ zhes byung ba ni/ sngar nyer bzhir bgrangs pa'i kañtsi yin la/ 'di nyid dang*/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i 'gyur mdzad pas/ tsa ri spyod par bsgyur te/ spyod dang ha ri ke la dang*/ zhes 'byung bas/ don spyi ming (4 na 7)skabs 'dir bye brag la btags pa bzhin du/ yul 'di la yang gdags su rung bas tsa ri tra'o zhes bzhag pa la klan ka mi nus so// de bas na/ rgyal dbang rjes/ spyod pa la yi ge bsnan pa'i bshad pas/ mkha' spyod dbang po zhes mdzad cing*/ sems dpa' rang byung rdo rjes/ tsa ri zhes pa bzhi yin te/ tra ya skyob par brjod par bya/ khams ni rnam pa bzhi bo la/ bde ba chen pos skyob pa'i phyir/ zhes dang*/ khrus khang lo tsa bas/ rnam par thar par bsgyur la/ de nyid dus 'khor las/ tsa ri tra ke na ra nyid/ bindhya kau ma ri ka'i grong*/ zhes 'thung gcod du bshad pa'i dang po dang*/ dgyes pa'i rdo rje las/ nye ba'i 'thung gcod tsa ri tra/ zhes gsungs pa'i tsa ri tra 'di yin par/ sgra bsgyur gyi dbang po mar pa'i zhal snga nas/ tsa ri tra ni lho phyogs thag nye ba 'di na/ rdo rje phag mo sha dang chang gis mchod pa'i gnas zhes bya ba yod de/ zhes gro bo lung gi seng ge'i khri chen po nas gsungs pa'i phyir ro// rgyud de gnyis su gsungs pa'i hi ma la ya ni 'di ma yin pas/ bye brag 'byed pa'i phyir lo tsa bas 'di la lha'i gangs ldan zhes bsgyur ba dang*/ gzhan la gangs can zhes pa dang*/ dri med 'od las/ 'khor lo gsum gyi sdom pa dang*/ kye rdo rje las/ bcom ldan 'das kyis snga ma dang phyi ma'i gsung 'gal ba gang yin pa de ni dbang po rnon po'i sems can rnams kyi 'dzin pa dgrol ba'i slad du ste/ 'dir 'khor lo sdom pa las/ gnas dang nye ba'i gnas la sogs pa gang yin pa de dag ni kye rdo rje las zhing dang nye zhing la sogs pas khrag 'khrugs su gsungs so// zhes dang*/ a bha yas man snyer/

gcig la ming sna tshogs pa ji ltar mi 'gal bas so// zhes 'byung bas/ yul gcig la ming dad ming can gcig tu zhen pa dag dgag pa'i phyir gcig la ming mang po dang*/ gcig nyid gnas dang zhing sogs khrag 'khrugs su gsungs pas so// gnas dang nye ba'i gnas zhes pa la/ gzhan dag /mkha' 'gro ma rtag tu bzhugs pa gnas dang*/ res 'ga' (4ba8)bzhugs pa nye ba'i gnas zer ba ni mi 'thar te/ rdo rje lus kyi gnas so sor rtsa mkha' 'gror gsungs pas/ rtsa des gnas/ res mi gnas pa med pas/ ji ltar phyi rol de bzhin nang*/ ji ltar nang bzhin phyi de bzhin/ zhes pa'i rgyud dad 'gal bar 'gyur bas so// 'o na gang yin zhe na/ de na gnas pa'i rnal 'byor ma rnams phan tshun phan 'dogs par byed pas nye bar btags shing*/ des zhing dang nye zhing sogs kyang shes par bya'o// de bas na/ gzhan dag /tsa ri tra zhes bya ba ni/ lho phyogs rgya mtsho'i 'gram na yong*/ tsa ri tswa gong 'di ma yin/ zhes pa la/ lho phyogs na yod ces pa tsam la skyon med de/ kañtsi rgya gar lho phyogs chos kyi grags pa'i yul dang nye ba grong khyer gyi mchog ces grags pa gser gyi liṅga lta bus mtshan pa de la'ang tsa rir bshad pas dang rgya mtsho'i 'gram na yod ces zer ba la rgyu mtshan ci yang med par shes shing*/ bod yul lhan cig skyes ma ni/ rdo ba'i phug la brten te gnas/ yul der gnas pa'i lha mo ni/ bha ṭa'i shing la brten zhes gsungs/ zhes pa zhing skyong ma brag gi phug la brten pa dang*/ bha dra'i shing la brten pa yul tha dad de/ dang po bod dang*/ gnyis pa de wi ko ṭar rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho/ mgon po dngos grub 'byung ba kun tu gsungs pas de dag dang 'gal ba dang*/ de yi phyogs na bha ṭa'i shing*/ yod na yul der 'gal ba med/ ces pa bha dra'i shing yod pa de wi ko ṭa bshad pas/ yul der 'gal ba med ces pa'ang 'chol la/ shing de di rang gis ston dgos te/

de wi ko ṭar khas blangs pas dang*/ 'dir shing de med na rang gis bkod pa'i gtan tshigs ma grub pas/ tshar gcad kyi gnas su lhung ngo*// ded kyis de wi ko ṭar ma smras so snyam na/ de wi ko ṭa'i gnas gzhan zhig /tsi ri yin zhes la la smra/ rdo rje mkhar 'gro'i rgyud las ni/ de wi ko ṭar bha ṭa gnas/ zhes/ tshigs dang por rang lags su bzhag nas/ de tsa ri yin pa dgag pa la lhag ma smras pa ci byung ba red soms (5 na 9)shig /lar kañtsi la bshad pa'i phyogs bzung nas/ 'di de'i tsa ri ma yin zhes smra na rang la cung zad shes par byed pa yod kyi/ de wi ko ṭar smras nas tsa ri yin par dgag pa ni smyon pa'i gar stabs rang ngo*// de ltar gtan tshigs kyi rigs pas ded na/ phyogs 'di la klan ka'i gnod pa nye bar zhibs/ rtog ge'i lce chad tsa ri tra zhes sbyar ro// gsum pa de'i ngo mtshar gyi bkod pa ni/ 'jig byed bsad pa'i khrag dmar rba glong gis/ zhabs mthil bgos pa'i dpa' bo he ru ka /sgrib gnyis dag pa'i ḍā ki dang lhan du/ bdud 'joms shel ri chos sku'i mchod sdong yin/ phyi yul snang la shar ba'i tshul mdo dang mthun la/ khyad par du 'phags pa sprul pa'i chos rgyal srong btsan sgam pos/ phyi g.ya' ri padma'i mu khyud ltar 'khor ba'i nang*/ tsa ri ri rab bang rim gsum pa'i tshul du chags shing*/ gsang ba dag pa shel gyi gangs ri bum pa'i tshul du lhun chags pa/ de bas rang byung lhun gyis grub pa'i byin rlabs kyi mchod rten chen po zhes bka' stsal ba ltar gnas/ nang rnal 'byor gyi gzigs mos gsang sngags phyi pa dang mthun la/ khyad par du 'phags pa ni/ slob dpon chen po padma sambha was/ gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i mchog */ yul sum cu rtsa bzhi'i gtso/ dur khrod chen po rngam pa sgra sgrogs pa'i lte ba la dpal tsa ri tra/ rang byung sprul pa'i lha tshogs bzhugs pa'i pho brang chen po 'di dag gi steng gi phyogs thams cad mkha' spyod rnam par dag pa rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i gzhal yas khang dpag tu med pa yod pa/

'og gi phyogs sa 'og spyod rnam par dul ba chen po'i pho brang rang bzhin bag lugs kyi gnas pa'i bar na rin po che gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa phreng bzhag gi rnam pa lta bu'am/ g.yung drung g.yas su 'khyil ba lta bu'i bkod pa ltar yod pa/ gsang sngags pha rgyud dang ma rgyud kyi lha tshogs thams cad kyang yab yum 'khril sbyor du 'od lnga'i tshom bu bkod pa ltar gyis lhun grub tu bzhugs pa/ zhes gsungs la/ de lta bu'i pho (5ba10)bde chen po de la 'jug par byed pa'i sgo sprul pa'i rgyal po dang slob dpon des/ shar sgo 'phags pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sgo/ brgya byin rnam par rgyu bzhes pa rgya nag po la gtad/ sgo srungs gshin rje gshed kyis byed/ sgo rtags su sne lung chu bar 'phrang gong zhes pa/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dang*/ rdo rje ging chen rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i dpa' bo dang dpa' mo gnas pa/ rgya la gshin rje'i dong kha dang*/ rdo yul ba ri gnyis sgro 'gram/ lho phyogs dpal phyag na rdo rje'i sgo/ gshin rje rnam par rol pa zhes pa rgya dkar po la gtad/ sgo srungs bdud rtsi 'khyil bas byed/ sgo rtags su byar jo bo them pa la gror phug ces pa rin chen mkha' 'gro dang*/ rin chen ging chen rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i dpa' bo dang dpa' mo gnas pa/ klo 'grim gling dang*/ bal yul yang le shod gnyis sgo 'gras/ nub jo mo sgrol ma'i sgo/ chu lha rnam par rtse ba/ u rgyan la gtad/ sgo srungs lha mo e ka dzā ṭi/ sgo rtags su la bar skye stong khang sgrom rgyal zhes pa/ padma mkha' 'gro dang*/ padma ging chen rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i dpa' bo dang dpa' mo gnas pa/ gshong dgon ta re ta dang*/ dpal gyi lha sa gnyis sgo 'gram/ byang thugs rje chen po'i sgo/ gnod sbyin rnam par 'khrigs pa bod la gtad/ sgo srungs ha ya gṛ bas byed/ sgo rtags su sles gad phug rgya'i dur stong zhes/

las kyi mkha' 'gro dang*/ las kyi ging chen rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i dpa' bo dang dpa' mo gnas pa/ gnas gong dpal gyi ljongs dang*/ bzho stod gter sgro gnyis sgo 'gram/ sgo de dag tu gnas pa'i dpa' bo dang dpa' mo rnams kyang gcig gshegs pa dang gcig skye/ gcig dar ba na gcig rgas pas gsum gsum nges par 'byung ba/ mtshams bzhin shar lho drang srong rngam byed kyi sgo/ lho nub srin po ro gzan kyi sgo/ nub byang rlung lha skyod byed kyi sgo/ byang shar drag po rtsal 'byin gyi sgo/ sgo de dag gi phyi rol du dur khrod chen po (6 na 11)brgyad/ rdo rje'i rab me ris yongs su bskor te gnas/ gsang ba rnal 'byor bla med ji lta ba ni/ slob dpon padma/ bi ma la/ skyob 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po rnams kyis gsungs pa/ rmad klu'i yul na spos kyi rgya mtsho yid du 'ong pa'i dbus na gser gyi padma 'dab ma 'bum dang ldan pa/ rdo rje'i snying po zab byas pa/ klu dang*/ mi dang*/ lha'i rin po che thams cad zil gyis gnon pa'i man shel dpa' bo'i gzhu'i mdangs bye ba phrag spel legs su bkod pa/ nyin mor byed pa 'bum ltar 'od gsal ba/ bsil zer can bye ba khrag khrig spungs pa'i sim pa ster ba/ yid bzhin nor bu'i dbang po thams cad phra tshom blta na chog mi shes pa/ mchod rten bkra shis sgo mangs kyi dbyibs can/ bcom ldan 'das byams pa'i 'dom dgu brgya pa re phyogs phyogs su snang ba/ seng ge'i khril sgo bdun cu rtsa gnyis la rgyal po chen po bzhi la sogs pa dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa gnyis/ dbus su dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa la sogs dam pa chos skyong ba'i rigs sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor bang rim bzhi la pa gam dang gdong chen re/ gdong chen rol rin po che'i mchod sdong brgyad brgya/ bang rim re la sgo nyis stong drug brgya/

de re ran rdo rje theg pa nas bshad pa'i dkyil 'khor re/ bum pa'i nad pho brang gling dgur bcad pa'i dbus mar/ drag po 'jigs byed kyi bam dang*/ dus mtshan ma'i snying khar gor mdzad pa'i bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa'/ 'khor lo sdom pa/ rigs brgyar bzhengs pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po thams cad snang ba bsdoms pas rigs kyi dbye ba nyis stong brgyad brgya'i lha tshogs bzhugs pa/ brel bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ ba gam dang gdong chen la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' sems ma/ chos skyong srungs ma/ khro bo khro mo bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ 'phags pa kun tu bzang po/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad la mchod pa'i sprin bung 'bul ba lta (6ba12)bus dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i pho brang*/ rdo rje phag mo'i dge 'dun sa/ dpa' bo dang*/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi grong khyer/ gsang ba gdul bya mtha' yas pa la 'dul byed 'byam klas bar snang ba'i sgyu ma chen po/ rgyud sde nas bshod pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad pa/ gsang sngags kyi chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi/ thun mong dang mchog gi dngos grub la 'gro ba ma lus pa mgron du gnyer ba'i thugs can/ gcig tu ma grub la/ thams cad par 'char ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mchod sdong chen po spungs sku kha phye ba lta bu'am til gyi gang bu 'dra ba zhes bsngags so// chos sku ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi rol mo mdzad sa/ thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i zhing brjod nas/ rigs ldan ma dang pho nya mor bcas pa/ kun tu spyod pa'i 'khor sa bcu gnyis ser/ dngos grub len la dpag bsam dbang po ni/ yongs 'du lta bu dam tshig mkha' 'gro'i rten/ mchod rten chen po de'i lho phyogs na/ pho brang chen po g.yu mtsho/ nyin mor byed pa'i 'od kyis gnam sngon po bzhu ba'am/ bai ḍūrya'i me long phyis pa lta bu dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor/

gzhan yang*/ 'od 'bar mtsho mo che stod rdo rje 'jigs byed dang*/ smad dgyes pa rdo rje/ skyog mo'i sindā ra'i rgya mtsho stod tshe dpag med smad gsang ba 'dus pa/ bde mchog bla mtsho stod bde mchog 'khor lo dang smad sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam par sbyor ba rnams kyi dkyil 'khor te dngos grub ster ba'i mtsho/ sgrol ma bla mtsho bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol ma ljang mo 'phrin las kyi lha tshogs/ chos 'byung zangs spa tsho ku ru kulle dmar ma dbang gi lha tshogs/ kun 'byung gser mtsho nor rgyun ma ser mo rgyas pa'i lha tshogs/ ka lā dung mtsho rnam par rgyal ma dkar mo zhi ba'i lha tshogs gnas pa 'phrin las sgrub pa'i mtsho bzhi/ mu men mthing mtsho thugs sgrol yum 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma/ dmar nag rakta sku dbyings yum e ka dzā ṭi (7 na 13)me 'bar mtsho gsung sbyor ba'i yum tsaṇḍi ka /bdud mgon bla mtsho dpal mgon po nag po'i lha tshogs gnas pas dgra bo dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i mtsho/ de dag ni rab la mtsho'i snang ba med par dkyil 'khor dang*/ 'bring la mtsho'i dbus nas padma'i sdong bu 'phags te/ de la lha tshogs rnams bzhugs pa dang*/ me long la gzugs brnyan bzhin du mtsho la 'char ba dang*/ mtha' ma la 'od dam/ phyag mtshan nam/ yig 'bru dang 'ja' 'od 'khrug pa la sogs par snang nas rang rang gi skal ba bzhin du dngos grub brgyad/ 'phrin las bzhi la sogs pa stsol bar mdzad de/ lha'i bu dag slong ba'i lag pa brkyang ba na shing yongs 'du sa brtol las 'dod pa thams cad 'byung ba bzhin no// de bas rigs ldan ma ni rdo rje phag mo dang*/ bdag med ma dang*/ reg bya rdo rje ma la sogs pa yin la/ pho nya ni rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sogs dang bcas pa'i bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa'/ khro bo'i tshogs rnams lhan cig spyod pa ste/ nyi ma'i dus kyi dbye bas pho brang bcu gnyis su grub bo// sna tshogs ljongs dang ri dang mtsho klung shing*/

las kyi mkha' 'gro nyams drod myul ba'i sa/ las 'phro bzang ngan brtag pa'i me long 'di/ sprul sku'i gnas yin skal med srog la gtum/ bi ma las/ byin rlabs rang byung de'i nub byang nas/ las kyi mkha' 'gro khrus byed pa'i mtsho brgya rtsa brgyad yod/ de dag kun na dngos grub re re thob pa'i gnas yod/ de'i shar du chu bo chen po zhig brgal ba na mkha' 'gro ma gsang ba'i gnas yod/ de'i pha bong la mkha' 'gro ma'i mtshan ma 'dra ba yod pa ni rlung sems kyi dngos grub thob pa'i gnas yin no// zhes rdo rje ra ba dang*/ bod rdo mtshan can yin la/ la wa pas/ dkar leb gong gsum gyi mtshams nas mkha' 'gro ma'i grong yod de/ snang ba dag pas grong khyer chen po brgya srang bzhi par mthong*/ 'bring gis ni la me'i khang bu/ mtha' mas rdo dang gra ma tho de bar mthong bar (7ba14)bshad pa yang rdo mtshan 'di kha'o// 'di ni ljongs chen po gcig go// byang na gshin rje'i 'du khang zhes bya ba/ drag po 'jigs byed kyi gnas yod do zhes pa ni/ cig car te/ 'di la rgyal po lam yig las/ tsa ri lung chung zhes pa phu lho la gtad pa/ mda' byang du bstan pa/ gcong rong dog pa/ chu rba tshub tu 'tshub pa/ na bun skyi bun du 'thul ba/ nub mer 'bar ba/ shing gdug pa can se'i nags la gcan gzan sna tshogs kyi tshang bcas pa/ rong de la gzab par bya'o// rong nag po de zad pa dang*/ cong zhi'i brag dkar po nyi zla shar ba ltar gsal zhing*/ nyams dga' la yid dngas te/ mkha' 'gro ma nyi ma'i spyan can bya ba dang*/ zla ba'i spyan can zhes pa gnas te/ cong zhi'i chu zho'am 'o ma'i tshul du 'bab ste/ khrus byas dngos grub blang zhes dang*/ la wa pa dang jo bo a ti shas/ lung pa'i phun bod kha gsum/ de nas mar phyin pa na/ spang dang thang zad pa na/ brag nag po yod de/ de'i chu 'bab pa'i g.yas na gser mtsho gru bzhi yod/ de dug mtsho/ klu gdug pa can yod/

dri ma gtang du mi rung*/ btung du mi rung*/ de'i mtha' ma zla gam du yod/ g.yon na dug mtsho gru gsum mdog dmar po mthong na snying mi dga' ba yod/ de la'ang dri ma gtad du mi rung*/ btung du mi rung*/ mtha' ma'i dbyibs ni zlum por yod/ de la gzur nas 'gro/ de nas tswa ri tswa gong yod la/ g.yu mtsho zlum po mtha' ma na/ bye ma la gser g.yu yod/ de phyi rim gseg ma/ de nas shel ri yod/ ces pa 'di las/ cig car la rtsa gong ngam rtsa mchog tu bshad cing*/ mi tra'i lam yig las/ khyad par gyi gnas tsa ri lung chung ste/ ka lā dung mtsho dang*/ g.yu mtsho skyog mo gnyis kyi bar na/ kha byang shar du blta ba/ phu lho nub tu bstan pa/ mda' gcong rong dog pa/ cong zhi'i brag srin po langs pa 'dra ba yod/ shing 'brug gu can gyi nags tshal gyis chod pa/ phu yangs pa slang 'dra ba/ de'i dkyil ni lte ba 'dra ba cig yod/ dzambhu gling gi me tog skyes tshad kyi rtswa tshang ba/ dbyar zla gsum me tog tu 'bar (8 na 15)pa/ zla ba yar ngo'i tshes bcu'i zla ba 'char ba dang*/ lung pa 'od du gsal ba/ gnas der sleb pa dang dbang po dngas pa/ rig pa 'char ba/ mchog tu nyams dga' pa yod de/ ri de'i rtse la prag dkar po dar dkar gyi gur phub pa 'dra ba cig yod/ de'i shar ngos na bong da nag po'i gleg cig yod pa de'i gseb na dngos grub kyi rdzas yod pa/ klu bdud nag po zhes bya ba/ dgun zla gsum rtswa'i gseb na gnas te/ bri tas 'dzin zhes bya ba/ dpyid zla gsum lo ma ru gnas pa sngo 'od ldan zhes bya ba/ dbyar zla gsum me tog tu gnas te/ kunda bde skyed ces bya ba/ ston zla gsum 'bras bur gnas pa/ sindha sa 'bru zhes bya/ de'i rtsa ba la phug 'dra'o// lo ma padma 'dra ba/ me tog dril bu 'dra ba/ nang na rdo rje rgya gram yod pa/ kha dog sngon po la smug po'i thig le yod pa/ 'bras bu bra pa brdzis na/ de'i dri byung bas ser ba shar shar 'byung ba/

sngo 'byung ba 'khrugs byed ces kyang bya'o// rlangs pa rta rnga tsam zhig 'thul lo// de la lha ma yin sde brgyad la sogs pa der nyi mi nus so// lag pa kab na tsha'ur 'ur 'ong ngo*// kha pa babs na rdo tshan la khab babs pa bzhin bzhu nus pa/ grog spur dang 'bu sbrang thams cad phyir spungs de 'chi/ bcad na thar nu ltar zho lhug gi 'ong ngo*// de lta bu'i rdzas de lon na mdze nag tho lum la sod pa yang*/ 'di khong du song ba tsam gyis gsos so// dri tshor ba tsam gyis kyang kru 'phros/ ro myangs ba tsam gyis kru brgyal 'gro/ lto ru song pa tsam gyis klu 'chi nus so// rtsa ba/ lo ma/ me tog /'bras bu bzhi ka tshad na/ lus sprul lkogs pa brjes pa bzhin du dkar 'thul la 'gro/ tshe'i rig 'dzin thob par nus so// lus shing bal gyi 'dab ma ltar dkar/ nam mkha' la (8ba16)bya ltar 'dur nus/ chu la mi bying*/ 'byung bzhi'i nang las thar/ thams cad dbang du 'du/ thun mong gi dngos grub sna tshogs 'byung*/ mchog gi dngos grub myur du thob bo// zhes dang*/ sprul pa'i rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos/ de ltar rtswa'i mchog tu gyur pas na spa mchog /rtswa de'i gong na gzhan med pas na rtswa gong zhes pa'o// 'dir zla ba dang nyi ma'i spyan can ma gnyis gnas pas spyan mtsho/ lte ba lta bu'i ri zhes pa/ bsil ba tshal gyi thad/ lte ba'i bug pa ltar 'khyil ba dang*/ dngos grub kyi chu yan lag brgyad ldan 'bab par bshad pas so// padma lam yig las/ gnas mchog dkyil 'khor chen po de'i byang na gnas phran cig yod de/ de yang dus kyi mthar/ grub pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor pa zhig gis 'byed/ de ni drug pa rdo rje 'chang gis byin gyis brlabs pa/ chos nyid rtogs pa'i gdengs dang ldan pa/ rdzu 'phrul ya ma zung ston par byed pa zhig gis phye nas/ ming yang cig car dpal gyi nags ljongs zhes bya'o// der rtse gcig gi bsgrub pa byas na lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes 'char ro// zhes nas cig car gsar ma'i gnas 'byed pa'i lung bstan dang bcas pa bshad do// byang shar na shing gi lha mo khrus byed pa'i gnas zhes bya ba thang bde ba la ri de'u 'bras spungs pa 'dra ba bkra shis pa'i gnas yod ces pa de yang mtsho dkar te/

zhing khams de yang gnam sa thams cad sgor mor snang ba/ dbus na bkra shis kyi ri de'u/ sman gyi ljongs ngo mtshar gyi nags tshal/ de'i dbus na mchod rten rang byung de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs til gyi gang bu lta bur bzhugs pa/ mdun da mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i pho brang*/ mtsho dkar la dngas pa dngul gyi gzhong pa 'oms bkang ba lta bu yod pa/ sems dpa' byung rdo rjes rong nas byon pas ma phyed par/ rol pa'i rdo rjes phu nas bya ltar du babs nas gnas sgo phye ba'o// byin rlabs rang byung gi shar na mkha' 'gro ma'i 'du khang bya ba dpa' mo'i gnas yod do zhes pa ni/ gsar ma yang mdzod de/ rnam pa rgyal ba'i khang bzangs su (9 na 17)grags pa lha'i chos bzangs kyi 'dun sa lta ba de na khrus kyi rdzing bu dang*/ rtse sa'i sman ljongs dang*/ 'chi med kyi tsho chu dang*/ rdo chu ngo mtshar ba yang yod do// shar lho na lha'i drang srong dmod pa grub pa'i gnas zhes pa ni 'od 'bar gyi tshal dang*/ phug stag ma la rten 'brel ci bsgrigs 'byung ba mngon gyur du 'byung ba drang srong gi dmod pas zin pa lta bur/ nub na 'jigs byed kyi tshal yod de zhes pa/ rong gi siṅgha la'i ri bo dang bcas pa'i tshal dur khrod rngam pa sgra sgrogs su grags pa ste/ de yang*/ brag dang*/ g.yang dang*/ gcong rong dang*/ nags dang*/ ri khros pa dang*/ brag nag po zur gyen du langs pa 'dra ba dang*/ srin po dang srin mo ral pa g.yengs pa lta bu dang*/ mi ro sbas pa 'dra ba/ rtsa shing thams cad rkang thang 'bros pa 'dra ba/ chu dar 'phyar ba 'dra ba la rlung gis bskyod pas 'ur ting dang*/ ldir ba dang*/ shang shang dang*/ 'ur 'ur chem chem zhes pa'i sgra dang*/ gzhan yang hūṃ hūṃ zhes pa dang*/ phaṭa phaṭa ces pa dang*/ pheṃ pheṃ bhyo bhyo zhes sogs kyi sgra du ma sgrogs pa/ ro gsar rnying char du 'bab pa/ ri dwags/ gcan gzan mi bsrun pa dpag tu med pa rgyu ba/ mkha' 'gro ma dang gnod sbyin dang*/

srin po dang*/ bdud de'ang gshin rje dang*/ ro langs dang*/ lha ma srin gtum po la la ni lus gcig la gdod sna tshogs yod pa/ mgo gcig la lus du ma dang*/ lag pa mang po dang*/ lto ba dang*/ mgrin pa dang*/ brang gi char yang kha mig sna tshogs pa nas me dang*/ chu klung dang*/ srog chags brgya stong mang po 'byin pa/ lus la 'jigs pa'i gshog pa 'tshang ba/ yan lag thams cad zhud pa/ gnam lcags dang rdo'i char 'bebs pa/ khrag gis rab gtong ba mi zad pa'i mtshon cha 'phang ba/ 'phong 'gyed pa/ ral gri'i thabs bshom pa/ la la rang gi lus stod smad phral nas glo snying ston pa/ la la yan lag bcad de 'thor ba/ la la gzugs sna tshogs su snang ba/ rgyob cig sod cig ces sgrogs pa/ sha dang khrag la dga' ba/ dkan tog pa sogs cho (9ba18)'phrul sna tshogs ston pa/ de na rang byung gi mchod rten rin po che las grub pa dang*/ ki'u rim brgyad kyi gzugs rang byung yod cing*/ chu ri munta zhes pa'i mtsho/ de'i lho nub na 'jig rten pa'i lha'i rten ngo mtshar can/ shing nag po ni ka ta zhes pa chen po zhig gi rtse la dur bya'i tshang*/ rked pa na dug sbrul nag po dang*/ rtsa ba na dur phag gi tshong yod par 'jig rten pa'i lha kun dga' gzhon nu gnas pa'o// lho nub dgyes pa rtse gsum 'dus pa'i sa bya ba/ dpa' bo 'du ba zhes pa la/ sprul pa'i chos rgyal srong btsan sgam pos/ thabs rdo rje ri la rdzogs rim sgrub pa'i gnas/ rten 'brel gyi rdo zil gnon zhes pa/ rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga nas blangs pa'i rdo rkang pa'i 'og tu bcug pa tsam gyis rdo rje'i gdan bgrod pas bdud thams cad zil gyis gnon par byed pa/ zhes dang yang*/ rin po che'i rdor chu zhes pa shin tu dang ba/ mgo bo bstan na klad pa gsal ba/ ro stod bstan na glo snying gsal ba/ ro smad bstan na rgyu long gsal ba/ 'thungs na lus rdo bar 'gyur ba'i phyir na bdud ces bya la/

a ru ra gser mdog bskyur na rten 'brel gyis gser du 'gyur te gser 'gyur gyi rtsi zhes bya'o// de ltar 'dud rtsi chu de la gdams ngag dang ldan pas nub gcig 'thungs pa tsam gyis lus rdo rje'i sku thob nas g.yung drung gi cho 'thob ces dang*/ yang*/ rdo rje rlung gi ljon shing zhes pa/ skad cig kyang mi gnas par skyod pa'i phyir/ skyod byed kyi shing zhes kyang bya/ shing lo thams cad bya sgro ltar 'phar ba/ shing de skyod pa'i mkha' 'gro mi rdo rje rlung gi gshog pa can zhes pa la gsol ba btab pa'i byin rlabs kyi mthus/ shing lo de lag tu thogs na rkang mgyogs kyi dngos grub rnyed do// shes rab dril bu'i bskyed rim sgrub pa'i gnas/ mkha' 'gro ma'i gsang ba'i bha ga nas byang sems dkar dmar gyi rgyun sindhu rar 'bab ste/ chu'i bcud/ sa'i zhag /bdud rtsi'i sman/ rten 'brel rdzas kyi nus pa kun ldan/ der mkha' 'gro ma tshogs pa'i glu (10 na 19)sgra rol mo thos pa la sogs ngo mtshar mang po 'byung*/ dbus na thabs shes rab zung 'jug dbu ma ri zhes pa/ bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug gi ting nge 'dzin rang shar rang lus 'ja' 'od du dngas/ sgyu lus 'od gsal du grol nas phyi gzung ba mi dmigs/ nad 'dzin pa'i sems mi dmigs/ dmigs pa thams cad nye bar zhi bas/ snang ba mod pa 'phags pa'i sa nas sa sbyangs te/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par 'gyur ro// bi ma las/ nub na tsa ri parpa te zhes bya ba/ rnam par mi rtag pa skye ba'i gnas yod do zhes pa/ la wa pas/ de yang*/ mda' shar lho bag che ba/ rdo rje gdan dang thad ka /phu nas 'gro ba'i g.yas na byar gnyal lo rong gsum gshibs pa/ g.yon na dkar leb rnam gsum dang*/ klo bo/ de'i phyi don/ kong po zhes bshad pa ma chen yin/ rgyal po dang btsun mo'i lam yig nas/ der yang srin mo dpal gyi rdo sku zil che na gsar ba'i phug pa/

rang byung rje'i mchod rten/ spor chen dpa' bo'i rdzong*/ spo mthon dpa' mo'i rdzong chung*/ sring mo lha'i ne'u ring*/ bdud rtsi klu'i chu mig /gur kum sman gyi spang ljongs/ 'bras bu shing gi nags tshal/ pha bong kha stag 'thab pa'i phrang rings zhes gsungs pa/ spor chen/ spor chung yod pas tsa ri pa tar bzhag /jo bo la'i gangs 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs mkha' la spyod pa'i mgon po la sogs pas ngo mtshar ba/ aṅgi ma mched gsum gyi zhing skyong ma gnas pa'o// rang byung chos sku'i mchod rten de'i phyogs bzhin mi 'gyur ba'i ri bzhi zhes pa/ shar na mchod rten bya rung kha shor/ lho na mkha' spyod ri/ nub na ri bo 'bigs byed/ byang na dpal ri zlum chen po la sangs rgyas stong rtsa gnyis bzhugs/ mchod rten de'i zur bzhi nas dngos grub kyi chu bo bzhi 'bab/ rong chen po bzhi 'chags pa'i shar du rgyal pos parpa rong zhes pa na/ sngags kyi srung ma e kwa dzā ṭi'i sku dngos su shar ba la chu'i zhal khebs gsol ba zhes pas/ parpa rong*/ de'i 'og na ye shes mgon po (10ba20)dang las mgon rang byung du yod pas mgon po rong du grags la/ de nas lha mo rong na tsaṇḍī ka'i sku rang byung la chu'i zhal khebs kyis g.yogs pa/ 'chi med kyi chu la sogs pa ngo mtshar gyi rdzas sna tshogs pa'i gling ngo*// rong gnyis pa ni/ sprul pa'i chos rgyal chen pos gsang ba'i bka' srung ni dngos grub kyi rtsa ri de nyid la gnas shing srung bar byed pa'i phyir re ma ti zhes pa tsa ri rong na dmar nag gru gsum 'bar ba rakta'i mtsho'i ngogs la sku dngos su 'char te/ rnal 'byor pa dam tshig dang ldan pa'i stongs grogs byed cing*/ bsgral bar 'os pa'i zhing rnams sgrol bar byed pa'i phyir/ gshan pa nam gru spun dgu ma mo bye ba'i tshogs kyis bskor nas bzhugs pa la na bun sprin gyi zhal khebs gsol ba'o// zhes pa 'od 'bar gyi rgyud nas dmar nag gi bar 'di'o// nub stag tshad rong la byed kyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi rgyu srang*/

mngon sum du mi nam mkha' la 'khyer nas tshogs kyi longs spyod du byed pa de'o// byang du ni do mtshang 'phra men gyi mkha' 'gro sprul bsgyur sna tshogs kyis skyi sbung ba de bzhi'o// la bzhi ni/ skyabs chen/ sha skam/ dga' yo/ sha dus bzhi la bshad cing*/ skyobs chen phug /'od 'bar phug /mkha' spyod ri'i rdo rje phug /mig ra phug rnams phug che na bzhi/ gzhan yang brtul zhugs grub pa padma'i 'byung gnas kyis/ las mtha' grub pa'i mtsho sum cu rtsa gnyis/ rkang mgyogs 'grub pa'i mtsho bzhi/ rgyas par na ma tsha nyi khri chig stong*/ sbas pa'i mtshon stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis skal ldan dngos grub len pa'i mtsho ni brgya nyi shu zhes dang*/ bi ma las/ byin rlabs rang byung gi mchod rten gyi mtha' kun yang*/ rin po che 'od zer 'byung ba kha dog sna tshogs pa dang*/ ri dang*/ brag lha'i zhal gzugs 'dra ba dang*/ shel gyi ri dang*/ shel gyi mchod rten sna tshogs yod pa'o// de nyid du// dus bzang po la mkha' 'gro ma rnams dang sde brgyad thams cad tshogs nas me tog gi char 'bebs/ spos kyi dri 'thul/ rol mo'i sgra (11 na 21)sgrogs pa/ mchod pa rnam pa mang pos mchod cing ri mor byed/ bsti stang du byed/ phu dud byid do// rnal 'byor pas kyang dus bzang po la bab pa'i tshe mchod gtor dang tshogs kyi 'khor lo brtsams na dngos grub myur du 'thob bo// gzhan yang*/ lung pa chu 'bab pa re na yang mkha' 'gro ma'i gnas phran re yod de/ gnas de dag kyang*/ rngam pa sgra sgrogs nas rim gyis gzung nas gzugs sna tshogs pa ston pa'i gnas dang*/ sgra sna tshogs pa sgrogs pa'i gnas dang*/ ri dum bu tsandan gyi dril 'thul ba/ sman sna tshogs yod pa/ ting nge 'dzin dpag tu med pa skye bar byed pa dang*/ nus pa thob par byed pa'i gnas dang*/ tshe ring bar byed pa'i gnas dang*/ longs spyod 'phel bar byed pa'i gnas dang*/

bcud len dang*/ mig sman dang*/ rkang mgyogs dang*/ sa 'og dang*/ mkha' spyod dang*/ mi snang ba dang*/ ril bu dang*/ mchil lham dang*/ mngon shes dang*/ 'phrin las drag po dang*/ dbang dang*/ rgyas pa dang*/ zhi ba ste thun mong dang*/ mchog gi dngos grub thob par byed pa'i gnas brgya nyi shu yod cing*/ der mkha' 'gro ma stong phrag re re gnas la mkha' 'gro ma la khrag gi ral pa bsnyil zhing*/ khrag 'thung bal mngon par dga' ba dang*/ la la mi ro za zhing sha la dad pa/ la la rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan cing bzhon pa sna tshogs la chibs pa/ 'dod dgur bsgyur ba/ la la ser mo gnod sbyin gyi byin dang ldan pa/ 'dod pa thams cad thogs pa med par char du 'bebs pa/ la la dmar po lcags kyu 'chang zhing*/ 'jig rten gsum dgug cing dbang du sdud pa/ la la dkar mo rin po che'i bum pa nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'thor bas nad dang sdug bsngal zhi bar byed pa/ la la ljang mo dang khra mo las sna tshogs kyis re bskong ba/ la la bdud dang srin mo dang*/ gshin rje pho nya khros pa'i gzugs mthing nag ral pa rting par drud pa/ nu ma phrag la gzer ba/ gus 'debs pa/ skad mi sdug pa sna tshogs sgrogs pa/ du ba dang*/ rgod pa dang*/ mi sdug pa'i bzhin dang*/ cha byad dang yan lag sna tshogs kyi ma skal (11ba22)dang ldan pa rnams kyi dpa' bkong bas ting nge 'dzin la rtsal 'byin pa/ skal pa med pa rnams kyi srog hur thums su blangs te zab/ mdor na/ srid pa gsum na ci snang ba thams cad der mi 'char ba med pa/ de lta bu'i gnas de nyid la yul nyi shu rtsa ba zhig tshang ba yang dri med 'od las/ yul gcig la yang gnas la sogs pa rnams gsungs pa'i phyir dang*/ zhes pas so// de'i rnam par dbye ba ni/ lo tsa ba bsod nams rgya mtsho'i sdes mdzad mod/ 'dir yi ge mang po'i 'jigs pas ma phye'o// bzhi pa gnas sgo phye tshul ni/ bod yul gyi bstan pa snga dar gyi dus sngags 'chang grub pa brnyes pa padmas lho sgo byar jo bo them pa la nas byon/

khril chen gsang ba'i phug tu lo bdun/ zla ba bdun/ zhag bdun gyi bar du bsgrub pa mdzad/ gnas chen po 'di'i gzigs snang thams cad gtan la phab/ zab chos kyi gter kha grangs med pa sbas la/ de las cung phyi ba ni bi ma la mi tras rdzu 'phrul gyis byon/ pho brang khar bzhugs nas mi ma yin la chos bstan/ bar du slob dpon la wa pa zhes pa'i mtshan mang du byung ba las/ 'di shar phyogs la wa pa/ jo bo a ti sha'i bla ma yin pa zhig ste/ de la nye gnas bhu su ku zhes bya bas/ o ṭi yā ṇa na/ bde mchog dngos su bzhugs pa der gshegs par 'tshal zhus pas/ o ḍi ā ṇa las byin che ba byang phyogs mtha' 'khob na yod pa der song gsung*/ khos phyin pas ma mthong*/ log nas byung ba la/ ngas grogs bya gsung nas/ shar sgo nas zhugs rwa rong nas byon/ thog mar cig car du phebs/ de nas ma chen la wa phug /de nas mkha' spyod ri'i 'dab rdo rje phug tu bzhugs pa'i tshe/ khyod 'og ma gir song la bu mo shon byed pa yod kyis/ de'i dbus ma 'khrid la shog gsung*/ spos phor thogs nas chos nyid rnam par dag pa'i sngags 'dren zhing phyin pas/ bu mo nyer gcig 'dug pa dang phrad/ dbus ma de drud nas phyin pas/ an cig lon pa dang*/ yid cig yengs pa'i mod la (12 na 23)bu mo de med par lag pa na la phug cig 'dug /der bu mo la phug tu song bsam nas/ slob dpon la zhus pas/ la phug khrus gsung*/ bkrus te gshogs la tshos gsung*/ tshos gda' zhus pas/ nga la yang phor pa gang drongs/ khyod rang yang 'thung gsung*/ der slob dpon la phor pa gang brims/ kho rang gis mi sha yin bsam ma 'thungs/ khyi zhig yod pa la bkru bshal dang lhan du byin pas/ slob dpon dang khyi gnyis mkha' spyod ri'i rtse la byon nas mkha' spyod du gshegs/ khu shul du lus te smre sngags 'don gyin slob dpon la gsol ba btab pas/ slob dpon slar log ste/ sku las lpags pa zul gyis bshus/

de la bde mchog drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi lha tshogs rang byung du yod pa snang ste rgya gar du log /bar chad med/ thun mong gi dngos grub thob par lung bstan/ slob dpon nyid 'ja' 'od du yal/ slob dpon la mkha' 'gro ma la ghi zhes pas dngos grub phul ba yin/ des na gnas 'dir ci la yang so ma nyi byar mi rung ste tsong kha pa chen po gnas bskor la byon dus rab tu byung ba chang 'thung du mi rung dgongs nas ma gsol bas zhabs la smyug tshal zug gshegs la thug /gzhan ci byas kyang ma phan/ gnas chen du chang la rtog pa byas pas lan pa 'dra dgongs te dam rdzas gsol bas gdangs so// zhes de nyid kyi rnam thar du 'byung ba bzhin no// de nas nye gnas log ste/ phyis thun mong gi dngos grub thob/ mtshan rakṣi ta/ zhes pa/ rje btsun lo tsa ba chen po mar pa'i bla ma brgya rtsa brgyad kyi gcig yin la/ phag gru nas brgyud pa la de lugs kyi gdams ngag 'ga' re yod do// sku'i lpags pa de gnyal du gnyos ston bra 'o ra pa chen po chos 'bar du grags pa de rje btsun ras chung pa'i dngos slob yin/ des gsol ba btab nas rje btsun gyi rdzu 'phrul gyi spyan drangs/ grong khyer snang khrar te/ de lta bra 'or gyi mchod rten gyi snying por bzhugs so zhes grags la/ a ti sha bod du 'byon dus slob dpon la wa pa la dkyil 'khor gyi zhal ston par zhus bdag lam (12ba24)yig bstan nas/ byang phyogs mtha' 'khob kyi yul na sgrub gnas yod der song gsung*/ jo bos kyang dngos su me phebs rung*/ gsang phu'i la sgang nas gnas 'di dpal 'khor lo sdom pa lū yi pa'i dkyil 'khor du gzigs nas bsngags pa mdzad do// phyi dar la dge slong 'tsho byed ces rgyal ba'i bstan pa la rgyal ba nyid lta bur/ bcom ldan 'das rang gis lung bstan pa/ chos kyi rgyal po zla 'od gzhon nu/ mtshan gzhan 'jig rten gsum na dgas po lha rje zhes/

nyon mongs pa dang shes bya'i sgrib pa'i nad drungs 'byin pa por bsngags pa des gnas chen sgam po brdar gyi ri zangs lung gi chos khrir nyi ma mang por/ 'di nas nyi ma shar lho'i mtshams sprin na bun 'ja' tshon du 'khrug pa'i sa pha gi na/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs mngon sum du bzhugs pa/ rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i pho brang chen po/ tsa ri tsa gong parpa ta zhes pa/ rdo rje phag mo sha dang chang gis mchod pa'i gnas/ las dang skal bar ldan pa rnams pa dngos grub thams cad yid bzhin du sgrub pa/ skal ba med pa rnams 'jig rten gyi mkha' 'gro sha khrag la dga' ba dag gi tshar gcod pa/ lha 'dre gdug pa can gyi srang sgo/ stag gzig /dom dred/ mi rgod/ sbrang bu trai la ta ka dang*/ trai ma bu ga la sogs pa rgyu ba/ sa phyogs thams cad me tog gi rigs bsam gyis mi khyab pas khebs pa/ dri zhim spos kyi rgyun mi 'chad pa/ rol mo'i sgra snyan pa khor mor grag pa'i gnas shig yod pa de'i sgo 'byed pa'i dus la bab pas/ khyod sus nus zhes phyag mdzub gtad pas/ gnas gnyan pas phyag mdzub la chu bur bdun shar nas phyi nyin nas/ reng bus btsugs te nyi ma gsum gsungs kyang khas len nus mkhan ma byung*/ nyi ma rting ma skye bo ye shes rdo rje la spyan ched gnyer gyis gzigs pa na/ skye sgom chen po de/ ga re/ bla ma rin po che nga la gsung bar 'dug snyam nas/ ngas 'gro bar zhu zhus pas/ shin tu mnyes te/ skye bo ye shes rdo rje dpon slob bcu gcig (13 na 25)gis dang po grum lung nas yar byon pas/ mgon po gri gug can gyis lam bkag ste/ nyin phyed nas na bun dang skyi bun 'thibs te lam ma rnyed/ res 'ga' sba logs bzhin du bsgril/ res dril bu bzhin du gsil/ res 'ga' rdo rje lta bur gsor te nam mkha' la 'phang ba byung ba/ de la gtor ma phul/ gsol ba btab pas/ khyod 'dir ma 'ong*/

gzhan du song gsung*/ mgon po de brag la thim/ da lta'ang brag logs de la sku gsal bar yod do// phyir log /la bar rgyal du sleb/ der 'ban btsun ma cig la gnas mal g.yar nas bzhugs/ de la lung pa 'di nas phar mis thar sa e yod/ lung pa ci 'dra yod dam/ khyod kyis 'gro e myong dris pas/ mo na re/ ngas 'gro ma myong*/ lung pa ji skad yod kyi'ang cha med/ 'on kyang nga la bu mo cig yod pa de tsa ri trar tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor bar 'gro ba yin zer zhing*/ dus bzang thams cad la 'gro yi 'dug /kha rtsang yang song*/ khyed rang rnams kyang byon dang*/ lam du phrad 'ong*/ de la dris shig zer/ de nas skye bo dpon slob kyis byon pa/ la rtsa na/ bu mo'i glu rgyang tse re byung ba dang*/ mkha' 'gro mar mkhyen nas/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor/ dri rtsad mdzad nas/ la brgal te/ bod kyi phug chung dkar por phyag phebs/ na bun dang skyi bun 'thibs/ lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul dpag tu med pa byung*/ 'khor rnams phug pa gzhan du brdzangs/ kho rang lha 'dra zil gnon gyi ting nge 'dzin la zhag bdun bzhugs pas/ ltas dang cho 'phrul rang sar zhi/ bod klungs kyis 'di na nyin mo du bar 'thul zhing*/ mtshan mo me ru 'bar ba zhig 'dug nas/ der byon pas/ nam mkha' chos 'byung la sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro/ rdo chos 'byung la rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ sa chos 'byung la rin chen mkha' 'gro/ chu chos 'byung la padma mkha' 'gro/ shing chos 'byung la las kyi mkha' 'gro rnams zhal gzigs/ khyad par jo chos 'byung ngam/ skye gnas la cong zhi'i ze 'bru yod par gzigs shing*/ tho (13ba26)rangs mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong can mche gsum gyis zhal mngon sum du bstan nas/ skye bo tshom nyal yar la longs/ yar la longs las skyabs 'gro 'dra gyis/ yar la longs la sems bskyed 'dra bsgoms/ mi tshe ko spu bzhin du ma phyin/ phung po slag thul bzhin du sbyangs nyen yod/

'ching ba thag rul bzhin du ma bcad na/ bag chags rte'u thor bzhin du 'brang nyen yod/ 'dod yon snabs lung bzhin du ma bskur na/ 'dod sred tshwa chu bzhin du 'khor nyer yod/ dam tshig srog mkhar bzhin du ma bsrungs na/ nyon mongs dmag dpung bzhin du 'thibs nyen yod/ ces gsungs nas/ rnal 'byor pa khyod sdug rus che ba/ lus srog la ltos pa med pa zhig 'dug ste/ cha lugs 'di lta bus bla ma'i thugs dgongs kyang ma rdzogs/ ma mkha' 'gro mnyes par yang mi 'gyur/ gnas tsa ri'i sgo yang mi phyed/ nang sprul pa'i lha zhal yang mi mthong*/ mchog thun mong gi dngos grub kyang mi 'thob pas/ gnas tsa ri'i sgo 'byed par 'dod na/ sang phod dus kyi da tsam na/ mgo la chu zhwa/ rkang pa la chu lham/ lag tu chu ber 'khyer las shog /spos kyi dud pa rgyu ma chad pa dang*/ thabs shes kyi rdzas ya ma bral bar khyer la/ ri gsum gyi rtsa nas kha glu dang ma bral ba gyis la shog /lung gsum gyi mdo nas rkang pa bro dang ma bral bar gyis la shog /tshogs dang gtor ma rgyun mi 'chad par thong la gsol ba drag po thob/ de ltar bgyis na gnas kyi sgo 'byed pa'i grogs nged gyis kyang byed zer nas/ rdo'i mtshan ma de la thim par gyur to/ de nas de res phyir ldog /sad pod de tsam na lung ji skad bstan pa bzhin du mdzad de byon/ gnas spyi gtsug nyi zla'i gdan steng na/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs/ bka' sgo mo 'di phye la lam sna drongs/ nang sprul pa'i lha zhal bstan du gsol/ sems snang ba rang grol byin gyis rlobs/ rkyen phyi nang gi bar chad mi 'byung zhing*/ mchog thun mong gi dngos (14 na 27)grub stsal du gsol/ bod rdo mtshan can la gsol ba 'debs/ bdud mgon nag po la zhu ba gsol/ bka' sgo mo la sogs pas gsol ba btab pas/ rdo rjer ba nub sgor gzigs/ de nas ngo mtshar ka lā brgyud de/ dang po 'od 'bar mtsho rnyed/

g.yu mtsho mjal snyam log byon pas/ rje zla 'od gzhon nus/ g.yu mtsho min da dung 'tshol gsung*/ thangs gnyis pa g.yon bskor du byon/ pho brang skyog mo rnyed/ g.yu mtsho'o snyam nas log byon pas/ g.yu mtsho min/ da dung rgyug /thangs gsum pa g.yas bskor du byon pas/ pho brang g.yu mtsho gzigs/ dag pa shrī 'khor/ nang sprul pa'i lha tshogs mngon sum du mjal/ zhing skyong gi mkha' 'gro ma mched gnyis kyis gling gi zas phul bas/ zhabs sa la mi reg pa sogs thun mong gi dngos grub brnyes/ phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa brtan/ de'i dus su/ gling de g.yas su bsnams/ bsom mkhar de g.yon du thogs nas go re mdzad cing*/ gnas mchog dpal gyi tsa ri 'di/ phal dang phal gyis bgrod pa yin/ 'jig rten bya ba gtong pa yin/ sems nyid snang ba rang grol lags so// lus srog thad la 'bor sa yin/ rkyen phyi nang bar chad skyong sa yin/ 'khor 'das kyis shan thang 'byed sa yin/ bsgom chen srang la 'gyags sa yin/ sems nyid brdar gcod sa yin/ nyams dang 'od gsal skyong sa yin/ dngos grub rnam gnyis len sa yin/ gnas mchog dpal gyi tsa ri 'di// grong ltag dgon chung phra mo min// dngos grub rdzas kyi gling chen 'di// 'dra srin mo brdungs pa'i kha chu min// mched grogs rdo rje spun tshogs 'di// 'tshong khang 'grim pa'i sgom chen min// zhes gsungs nas/ nyams 'ur ba skad mdzad de/ phyag ber brag la rgyab pas 'jim pa la bsnun pa ltar song*/ de'i rjes da lta yang yod la/ de nas mi thog gcig thal ba na/ skyob pa 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon pos/ shar dgas lha (14ba28)sgam po'i gdan sa mdzad ri bo shānti'i rtse nas tsa ri'i gnas phyi nang gsang ba'i tshul thams cad mngon sum du gzigs nas/ gnyos chen po rgyal ba lha nang pa/ 'gar dam pa/ dpal chen chos yes te slob ma'i mchog gsum brdzangs/ de dag gis dgas po grum lung brgyud phyin pa/

bya gong mo gsum song ba'i bshul 'brangs pas gong mo la rnyed/ bod kha sum du phebs pa dang*/ gtsang pa rgya ras jo mo kha rag na sgrub pa la bzhugs pa'i tshe/ tho rangs mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can lan gsum gyi bar du byon te/ rgya ras pa/ tsa ri'i gnas kyi sgo 'byed pa'i dus la bab pas song zhig ces lung bstan pa na/ dgos pa cher med dam snyam ste/ de kar bzhugs pa las/ kha rag gi ri rtse la nyi ma shar ba tsam la/ grub thob chen po gling ras pa 'ja' tshon sna lnga pa'i gur khyim du bzhugs zhig byon nas// bu rgya ras ma sdod sgom du rgyug /tsa ri sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor na/ mkha' 'gro rdo yi snying phug yod/ gling chen zas kyi dngos grub yod/ ma dang mkha' 'gro'i byin rlabs yod/ ma bsgoms sangs rgyas de na yod/ ces gdams pa'i mod la yal ba'i snang ba zhig byung nas/ tsa ri la 'byon pa'i dgongs pa mngon du btang*/ rim pas 'bri khung tshun phebs/ grogs rnams rang rang gi yul la slog /nyid rnams shes bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi ngang nas rlung thun gcig bzung byon pas/ de'i nyin rang la bod kha gsum du phebs/ gnyos 'gar chos gsum dang mjal/ khyod su yin zer/ nga gling ras gsus bo che'i slob ma rgya ras mig po che yin gsungs pas/ 'o na khyod da gar 'gro zer/ gnas tsa ri'i sgo 'byed pa la 'gro ba yin byas pas/ khong rnams na re/ de la tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i rgyu thabs shes kyi rdzas dgos pas/ 'khor g.yog mang po dang bcas te 'gro dgos/ gzhan mi bgrod zer ba la/ khyed rang rnams de bzhin mdzod/ kho bo de la ma ltos pa zhig yin gsung*/ thabs shes kyi rdzas ni sha dang chang la bzhag par snang ngo*// khong rnams dang lhan cig par byon pas/ (15 na 29)khye'u chung gzhon nu rta gser g.yu'i rdog ma yod pa zhig la zhon pa cig byung nas/ bla ma rnams 'di nas yar phebs na rib pa zhig las med pas/ zhes gsol ba bzhin byon pas/

de phyin rib pa lar grags so// 'di nub phyang gi sgo yin/ de nas mkha' lding brag 'og tu phebs/ der bzhugs pas/ gnyos byon te/ grogs po rgya ras kyi bzhugs sa 'di skyid/ ces yang yang gsung pas/ dgyes na grogs por mdzod/ ces phul/ yang*/ mar thabs cig tu byon/ sbal pa g.yu mtshor phebs pa na/ spal pa g.yag shad tsam 'jigs su rung ba zhig gis lam bkag ste gtong ma nyan/ de la gnyos kyis ting nge 'dzin bsgoms na e zhi/ 'gar dam pas rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bskyed rim bsgoms pas e zhi/ dpal chen chos yes gtor ma btang na e zhi dgongs tsa na/ chos rje rgya ras kyis de'i rgyab tu the tshom med par mchongs pas/ gnyos chen po na re/ grogs po dam pa/ de 'dra ma mdzad/ klu 'di zhe gnag pas grogs po rang gi sku tshe la yang gzan/ phyi rabs kyi rjes 'jug la yang gnod gsungs pas/ rje rgya ras kyi zhal snga nas/ nga tshe ring yang lnga bcu rtsa gcig yin/ thung yang lnga bcu rtsa gcig yin/ ma 'ongs pa na them pa'i 'og nas chu mig cig 'byung*/ de'i dus su nga'i rjes 'jug rnams gnas 'di nas 'pho bskyas ni gang na'ang byed dgos par gda'/ gzhan ci yang mi lto gsung nas/ sbal pa de drag tu brdzis pas/ pha bong zhig tu gnas gyur/ de la zhabs rjes shin tu bkra ba mang du byung*/ cho 'phrul zhi/ de nas yul smad du phebs pa na/ ye shes dang las grub pa'i mkha' 'gro ma 'bum tshogs pa'i gral la byon/ der gdan chags pa na/ 'gar dam pa byon nas/ grogs po'i bzhugs gnas skyid ces gsung ba la/ thugs la 'thad na grogs dam pa rang mdzod ces phul/ de nas chos rje rgya ras kyis skyobs chen la kha nas cig car du gshegs pa na/ mi ma yin gyis mo (15ba30)mtshan mang du sprul nas lam bkags pa na/ gsang ba'i rdo rje las su rung bar mdzad nas de la bsnun pas/ brag tu song ba la/ de'i rjes gsal bor dod// rdo'i snying phug rnyed/

der zhing skyong gi mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje g.yu'i sgron ma dam pa btags/ de na re/ ngas khyed kyi chos skyong byed zer ba la/ kho bo la bud med kyi chos skyong mi dgos gsungs pas/ rje btsun nyid la mi dgos kyang*/ ma 'ongs pa na khyed kyi rjes 'jug gis gnas 'di 'dzin par 'dug /de'i dus su kho mo cag gis g.yag gi rdzi bo byas kyang chog ces zhal gyis 'ches/ sman btsun chen mo nges las kyi phyag rgya mdzad/ zhing skyong seng ge'i gdong pa can gyis ci bsgo ba thams cad nyan par dam bcas/ de nas mar phebs/ rang byung rol pa'i khril 'khod dus phyogs skyong gshin rje'i rgyal po khye'u lo brgyad pa'i gzugs yid du 'ong ba'i tshul gyis spyan sngar 'ongs/ dge bsnyen mnos/ mtshan cig car dmar por gsol lo// sngar gyi la la mdzad nas thegs pas/ khong rnams dang sha skam la rtser phrad/ de ring grogs po rgya ras kyis tshogs bshoms mdzod/ ces zhus pas/ de ltar bgyi'o zhes zhal gyis bzhes te/ sngon la rlung thun gcig bzung nas gshegs pas/ zhing skyong gi rub gzigs/ de la slongs pas mar thud bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung*/ grogs rnams sleb pa dang*/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgyas pas bskor/ ma yog pa rnams der spungs pas dkar rdog thang zhes grags te/ da lta dkar gong du gnas gyur pa'i phung po chen po zhig go// zhig mo khrag khri tshun lhan du phebs/ de nas nyi ma'i dgung la smag rum song skar ma khrag khrig tu gyur nas/ gnyos 'gar chos gsum gyis 'byon pa bshol/ chos rje rgya ras pas/ gling chen zas kyi dngos grub 'dug /ma dang mkha' 'gro'i byin rlabs yod/ sgom chen srang la gdegs sa 'dug /chos pa'i tshang rdo bor sa 'dug /nga rnal 'byor (16 na 31)rgya ras kyi 'gro sa 'dug /ces gsungs nas tsham tshom med par thegs/ dmar nag raktar brtol/ lha mo e ka dzā ṭi 'khor bcas kyis zhal bstan/

dam tshig nod pas/ char ci che yang*/ 'brug pa'i slob rigs dam tshig dang ldan pa 'dir sleb dus ras gos bskams pa'i nyi ma tsha lhang ba re nges pa kho nar 'ong zhing*/ 'brug pa'i bstan pa la dge mi dge mtsho de'i gang 'grib la shes pas/ 'brug pa'i bla mtshor grags so// de nas pho brang du gshegs/ nang sprul pa'i lha tshogs mngon sum mjal/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo sdom pas bskal bzang 'di la sangs rgyas mos par 'tshang rgya ba dang*/ bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje btsun mo'i phag mos/ bstan pa bya rgod kyi nyin lam bco brgyad kyi bar khyab par lung bstan/ der chos rje rang gi phug pa ya gir nga'i slob ma sa bcu nod pa zhig yong zhes/ phyis rgyal ba rgod tshang pa 'byon par lung bstan/ de nas rgya ras 'phrang brgal te/ sindū ra'i mtsho yod pa'i ngogs su bzhugs pas/ chab mkha' 'gros rdo'i yur bar drangs te phul/ de dus sindū ra'i mtsho de las chu bur brdol ba'i tshul du ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma 'thon te/ nyid kyi skra la btags pa'i mig ra phul bas/ phug chen de la de nas rgya ras mig ra phug tu ming chags so// phyir yul stod du 'khor nas/ de'i rgyab ri rdo rje phag mo lta bu sdong po kha ṭāṃ ga 'dra ba'i 'og tu smyug spyil mdzad nas zla ba gsum bzhugs pas/ tho rangs shig sgra 'ong dang*/ spos kyi dri zhim po bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung ba'i mod la sangs rgyas rab bdun mngon sum du byon/ rten 'brel gyi gdams ngag thams cad gnang*/ shes bya ji snyed pa thogs pa med par mkhyen pas mkhyen gnyis mthar phyin gyi sangs rgyas su grub bo// de dus gnyos 'gar chos gsum gyis tsa ri 'khor dgongs/ skyob (16ba32)pa'i spyan sngar byon pas/ bka' las/ dmar nag zhal ma mjal ba 'dug pas/ tsa ri ma 'khor gda'/ slar log gsung rdzong ba mdzad/ gnyis pa la/ da dung cig car ma 'khor/ de na nga'i khyad par gyi lha bzhi yod pa ma mjal ba 'dug gsung*/

gsum pa rdzong grub stsal/ de dus gnyos chen pos cig car du dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor 'dug pa'i gral du byon/ der bzhugs nas gnyos kyi rdo gcal du grags/ 'di nas 'og tu phag zhal can rang byon/ steng du mkha' la spyod pa'i phag mo/ bar 'dir sa spyod kyi phag mo 'byon pa'i dus la bab pas/ khyod kyis rtsol ba byos shig /ces zhing skyong gyi mkha' 'gro dag gis bskul ba las/ bdag padma dkar pos rdo rje phag mo bden gnyis zhal gyi lha khang bgyis so// de dus yang sa'i phyogs 'dir dpa' bo dang dpa' mo'i glu gar gyi phreng ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ der 'dus pa kun gyi rna ba'i bcud len du 'ongs so// lan gsum pa de la gnyos 'gar chos gsum gyis nang sprul pa'i lha tshogs ji lta ba mjal bar gyur to/ bla ma dam pa bzhi po de'i 'phrin las yul stod du las mtshan bco brgyad 'chags pa'i drug 'brug pa/ gcig zhang tshal ba/ gnyis gdan sa thel ba/ lhag ma 'bri khung pa'o// khong rnams byon pa'i dus su/ yul stod na dbye bsgom zhig po zhes pa rnal 'byor pa phyag rgya can/ dpal phag mo gru pa'i zhal slob de bzhugs yod pa/ gnas chen 'di rnal 'byor pa chung ma can gyis gzung na mi mdzes snyam nas/ khong rnams kyis gsol bas/ dgyer sgom rgod ma dkar mo zhig la chibs/ phyir bzhud pa'i la de la rta dkar du grags/ dkyus mdo'i phug tu bzhugs/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i sku gdung gi mchod rten yang de na snang ngo*// khong 'byon dus me cha der lus pas/ nga'i shul na yang du pha ma chad tsam yod pa 'dug gsung ba/ phyis snye phu shug gseb pa'i ri pa tshal pas brdzangs/ da lta'i (17 na 33)gtsang pa yin/ de phyis/ rtsad nag phug pa thugs rje seng ges bzung ba nas 'brug par song ngo*// rgyal ba rgod tshang pa pho ma lha khab tu bzhugs dus sa gdon gyi zhags shig byung*/ gzhan ti se dang*/

dzā landha ra sogs su byon kyang mthon/ phyis 'dir byon/ sku stobs che bas/ tsa rir nad pa dang snyom chung phal mo che'i 'tsho ba phyi nas blangs kyin bskyal bas/ sku rgyab thams cad rma ri song*/ de dus gzhan dag gis/ khyed 'brug pa'i bod rgan dmar po da nged la g.yar thong zer ba byung*/ de tshe sku'i nang rol thams cad phyir 'thon pa rmis/ da 'di mi ldog gam byas pas/ mi dkar po zhig na re/ brtson 'grus chung na ldog zer/ de dus sdig pa thams cad dag /bsnyun gzhi de 'thon/ thugs dam la bogs bla na med pa byung*/ tsa ri'i ri sul mang po re sgrub pa la rtse gcig tu bzhugs/ cig car phu'i sgrol ma la yang 'dis dbye/ mgon po rong gi bya gdong gnyan drags nas/ skor mi brgya kha longs pa na der mi re 'chi bas 'dis zhal phyir slog pa nas rgyun chad/ 'od 'bar mtsho mo che na g.yu rdog chen po zhig yod pa/ rjes bsom ber 'di la 'byor shog cig gsungs pas/ bden tshig gis de la 'byar te phyag gi padmor lon/ de las tshan rnams kyis hab thob byas pas/ rtsod pa'i gnas su song na mi legs dgongs nas/ khyed rnams 'od 'bar mtsho khar song*/ ngas slar der g.yu rdog 'phang gi gsung ba la/ de ltar bgyi zhes/ khong tshos mtsho khar bsgugs pa la/ yul stod nas g.yu rdog 'phangs pa mtsho nang du chog ces song bas khu thag chod/ de nas pho brang dbu rtser byon/ nam mkha' phug tu lha tshangs pa dam la btags dus der pho brang chen mo dkyil 'khor du zhal gzigs/ khwa gdong mas thun mong gi dngos grub ci 'dod 'di ba la/ thun mong gi dngos grub bdag la dgos pa med/ mchog 'dod ces gsungs pas/ gser g.yu mu men gyi skyogs gang gtso bo la phyag rten du 'bul rgyu stsal te/ gtso bo yab yum mjal/ (17ba34)mchog gi dngos grub tshe 'dir brnyes pa'i lung bstan te/ de nyid kyis da tsa ri'i nags la bsgoms tsa na/

nang sprul pa'i lha zhal mi bzhin mthong*/ thun mong cig bsgrubs na 'grub tshod gda' ste/ kho bo mchog la gzhol ba'i rnal 'byor pa zhig lags so// zhes gsungs/ 'di las cung zad phyi tsam na/ grub pa thob pa brgyad brgya tsam der tshogs pa'i dbus su/ u ri dbon po tog tu 'thon pas tsa ri ras chen du mtshan gsol/ de dag mchod pa la sogs pa'i dus su/ nam mkha' la 'phur nas 'byon pa de'i sa la bya 'phur sgang du thogs/ mi rabs gcig 'das pa tsam na/ rje spyan snga dang 'bri khung gling pa'i slob ma gang zag ya brgyad du grags pa byon/ de dag gis gsar ma yang mdzod kyi gnas sgo phye/ de'i phyi logs su tsa ri'i gnas 'di phal mo cher ltas mi shes pa du ma byung*/ de tsa na sa skya pas hor dmag bos/ 'bri khung bcom/ mchod rten sgo mangs dag pa shrī'i bkod pa can lha nyis stong brgyad brgya bzhugs pa'i ngo mtshar dpag par dka' ba de bshig /dge 'dun khri tsha bco brgyad me lnga bsregs pa las/ de'i nang nas rdzu 'phrul thob pa brgya nam mkha' la 'phur te mnga' ris glo bor chags so// dkar brgyud rin po che'i bstan pa la de dus las gnod pa che ba sngar ma byung zhing*/ phyis mi 'byung zhes rnam par grag go// de nas kyang mi thog gcig tsam brgal ba na/ 'brug pa'i las tshan te cang shed ches pa tshal pa rnams kyis ma bzod par sdong po kha ṭwāṃ ga bcad/ thod khrag gi rnam pa'i mtsho brtol/ sku'i nu rdog lta bu'i pha bong bcag pa dang*/ sngar chos rje gtsang pa rgya ras kyis lung bstan pa'i rdza khrod shar/ de'i spang chen gyi them 'og nas chu mig brdol pa rnams kyi gnad la brten/ 'brug pa'i las 'dzin sdud dgos pa shar/ des dgas kong rnams su ma mo khros pa'i nad dang dal khas ma phyugs phal cher shi bas/ rkyen pa rgyal po stag rdo rje la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' mi bcu gsum gyis gdan sa/ (18 na 35)chen po dpal ra lung thel du phyin/

de dus khri 'dzin chos rje spos skya pas mdzad pa'i skabs/ rje'i drung du zhu ba gsol bas/ chags sdang byed pa'i gnas su ri ba mi gtong dgos pa med gsungs pas/ rgyal po stag rdo rjes gri rked pa nas phyung ste ri thos mi gnad na/ 'di khar lcebs nas shi sdod pa ma gtogs mar log mi 'gro/ phyin kyang ma mo'i dal yams kyis 'chi ba las 'os med ces gnad du phog pa'i zhu ba gsol bas/ chos rje'i gsung nas/ khyod gcug la de tsam mchis na/ ri thos gtang gis gsung zhal gyis bzhes/ 'gro mgon khyod rang gis 'doms gsungs pa las/ gral gyi dkyil smad na 'gro mgon bsod nams rgyal mtshan sku gzhon la the ba zhig 'dug pa/ rgyal pos sor rtse gtad nas zhus pas gnang*/ 'di gnas nang ri pa'i mgon dang*/ 'brug ra lung nas dge 'dun sum cu tsam dang*/ gzhung nas 'gran ras kyi dbon po/ chos sku bde ba chen po dpon slob rnams phyi'i yon bdag /ri ba rnams skyong bar/ chu bo ri/ la kha shar/ byang dbu ri/ stod zangs zangs ne rings sogs nas las tshan so so bos te rdzong mthar mdzad la/ de yang rje'i gsung nas/ nged la zhing skyong gi nu bo cig car dmar po zhes pa khrag mdog sha'i ral pa can zhig gis phul ba'i gnas cig car dpal gyi nags ljongs zhes pa yod kyis/ der song gsung*/ de gan mchi zhus pas/ chos zam gdong nas chu 'bab bcu gsum bgrod pa na/ ne ma g.yu'i maṇḍal lta bu gsum brtsegs yod pas de'i khar rgyob gsung ba bzhin/ khong rnams kyis byon/ chos zam gdong nas chu 'bab 'dren gyin phyin pas/ sen mo gong mar go/ der gdan phab ste bzhugs pa'i nang par nyi ma rtse shar la/ bud med sngo bsangs ma dre'u la zhon pa cig chu 'gram nas yar song*/ de'i rjes la 'gro mgon gyis byon pas/ bud med de zam gdong gi brag de la thim/ de nyid du (18ba36)yud cig bzhugs pas/ khye'u lo brgyad tsam lon pa dmar po sha'i ral pa khrug ge ba cig byung nas/

khyed kyi gnas kyi lam 'di nas yar yod pa yin pas byon cig zer nas/ 'gro mgon gyi na bza' nas bzung ste gdan drangs pas/ 'gro mgon gyi zhal nas/ da lta thar byung*/ khal g.yag rnams ji ltar bya ba gsungs pas/ khong rnams 'di nas byon pas chog ces/ g.yag rab 'og bstan/ 'gro mgon byon sa der phyis zam pa gtsugs pas/ lha mo za ma gdong du grags/ de nas thams cad cig car gyi ne'u gsing bar mar phebs dus 'gro mgon gyis rgyal po la mda' phongs gsungs pas/ rgyal pos mda' 'phangs pas/ sems can ma bu bdun langs song*/ der 'gro mgon gyis rgyal po la lan gsum gyi bar du dris pas/ rgyal pos kyang lan gsum gyi bar du rgya yin/ zhes gsol pas/ rten 'brel bzang*/ rgya shul rgyas 'dzin par 'dug /ces lung bstan pa'i sar spang mo btab pa yin no// 'di byang sgo/ deng sang tsa ri skor ba la gnas sgo phyi ma phye ba 'di ches phan thog par gyur la/ 'gro ba'i mgon po 'di yang padma lam yig nas ji ltar bshad pa'i skyes bu chen po de'o// lnga pa de bskor ba gsang chen gyi lam rim par bgrod pa'i brdar bstan pa ni/ e ma ho/ dad pa'i snyim pa kha phye nas/ mchod pa'i yo byad 'di yi phyogs 'thor ba/ rtag chad lam gol bgag pa'i sgo glegs zhes/ rgyu 'bras myur po'i 'gram gyis gsal bar byas/ de lta bu'i gnas chen 'di rgyu 'bras lhun grub tu spyod pa'i zhing khams yin pas/ 'di'i phyogs su dad pas mchod pa'i yo byad gtod pa de dag la 'bras bu bsam pa'i re ba thams cad mod la 'grub par 'gyur bas na mu stegs byed dag gi 'dod pa bzhin/ 'jig rten dbang phyug dang*/ tshangs pa dang*/ khyab 'jug la sogs pas byas pa dang*/ rgyu med pa dang*/ ngo bo nyed rgyur byas bdag ma yin pa dang*/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba (19 na 37)yin par rtogs pas/ sdig pa spong*/ dge ba sgrub pa ni lugs bla na med pa skyes bu chung ngu'i lam zhes gsal bar bstan no// khyim nas rab byung zhen med chas gos kyis/

grub pa'i bshul rjes lta ba'i shes rab dang*/ rtse gcig bskor ba'i ting 'dzin chen po 'dis/ chags bral lam gyi khengs pa thung ngur bsnyil/ de yang*/ gnas chen po 'di bskor ba'i tshe/ khyim nas byung ste/ zhen pa med pa'i chas/ chu zhwa/ chu lham la sogs sgeg chos kyis mi mthun phyogs su gnas pa dga' 'chang ba/ sngar gyi grub pa thob pa'i bshul snyeg pa dang*/ yid rtse gcig pas skor ba bskor ba ni khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung dgos pa dang*/ de yang shākya'i rgyal po gtso bo de'i rjes su slob pas tshul khrims phun sum tshogs par gnas te/ thos bsam gyi shes rab bskyed par bya ba dang*/ yid 'du 'dzi la ma chags pa rab tu dben pa yid byed kyi ting nge 'dzin dang*/ sgom byung gi shes rab skyed dgos pa skyes bu 'bring nyan thos dang*/ rang sangs rgyas kyi lam thams cad legs par bstan no// byams pas rab brlan snying rje'i 'dam rdzab tu/ thabs shes zung gi gom pa 'dor mkhas pa/ pha rol phyin pa'i snying po 'di yin zhes/ dgongs nas skal bzang yun ring de la dkris/ de yang rab tu brlan pa'i ne'u gsing la/ gom pa legs par 'dor ba yun ring por bya dgos pa ni/ byams pa'i rlan gyis brlan pa'i snying rje'i 'dam rdzab tu thabs kyis 'khor bsdud pa dang*/ shes rab kyis de mya ngan las zla bar byed pa'i byang chub kyi sems la yun ring por sbyang ba skyes bu chen po'i lam/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa dag gi snying po'o// zhes gdams so// bod klungs chos 'byung chen po'i sgor bcug nas// gnas srung gnyan po'i dam tshig nod rnams la// dpal gyi gnas su nyams rtogs cig 'char ba'i// byin bab de la dkyil 'khor ma lus bstan// de nas bod rdo mtshan can (19ba38)nas gsol ba btab ste sgor zhugs/ gnas srung gnyan pa 'di lta bu yod kyis bag dang ldan pa dgos pa la sogs bsgrags/

cig car du dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma dag gi pho brang du dngos grub bsgrub pa dang*/ 'phrin las sgrub pa/ dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i mtsho thams cad ston pa ni/ rdo rje theg pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po la/ dang por nang 'jug /de nas dam tshig dang sdom pa len pa dag la gsang ba'i 'jug pa/ byin 'bebs byas nas/ dkyil 'khor chen po ston pa brdar bstan pa'o// yid can sdig la cher gnag sprin gyi bum/ sad pa'i skabs bgag na bun mgul dkris nas/ thugs rje'i chu rgyun phab nas lus bkrus pa/ dag byed phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang bskur yin/ phyogs thams cad sprin sngon po rab tu 'khrigs shing*/ na bun 'thul ba/ char gyi rgyun mi zad par 'bab pa ni lus can rnams kyi sdig pa la cher gnag pa'i bum pa bzang po ras dkar gyi zur phud tsan nas bdud rtsi lnga'i rang bzhin gyi chab 'ongs te/ lus kyi thig le sad pa'i gnas skabs spro ba/ rags pa'i sdig sgrib 'khrud/ sku rdo rje'i nus pa 'jog pa bum dbang ngam phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang bskur ba ste/ bskur mkhan ni mkha' la spyod pa'i dbang mo rnams so// zhes pa'i brda'o// rong bzhi'i nang 'bab la bzhir 'dzeg pa yis/ nyi zla'i bgro da pa la rmi lam skabs phral nas/ gsang ba'i tshogs rdzas longs spyod 'di kho na/ snod ldan rnams la gnyis pa zhes bsgrags so// rong chen po bzhir babs nas/ la chen po bzhi la 'dzeg la/ de dag tu tshogs kyi 'khor la du ma bskor ba 'di yang bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i bcom ldan 'das kyi khu ba dang*/ bcom ldan 'das ma'i rdul rtsa stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis nas 'khor lo bzhi'i rong du 'bab pa dang*/ de nyid slob ma rang rang gi 'khor lo bzhi'i lar 'dzeg pa/ gsang ba'i rdzas bdud rtsi lnga khar myong bas te/ ngag gi thig le rmi lam gyi gnas skabs skyed pa phra ba'i sdig sgrib 'khrud/ gsung rdo rje'i (20 na 39)nus pa 'jog pa'i dbang gnyis pa gsang pa'o zhes bsgrags so// de nas bcu gnyis gling gi pad can gyi/

khu ba 'thungs pa ri bzhi'i rtser son te/ gnyid 'thug mun pa 'joms pa nam mkha' yis/ thig ler rab gnas gsum pa zhes par btags/ de yang pho brang bcu gnyis la sogs pa'i mtsho'i chu 'thung zhing*/ ri bzhi'i rtser son pas nam mkha'i thig le nyi ma lta bur gsal ba nyid du gyur pa ni/ phyag rgya padma can gyis bzhu ba'i byang chub kyi sems dkar dmar 'dres pa gsang ba'i sna rtses 'thung ba/ dus der sku gsung thugs ye shes kyi thig le 'dzag med du bsdam nus pas yid kyi thig le gnyid 'thug gam snyoms 'jug gi gnas skabs skyed pa shin tu phra ba'i sdig sgrib 'khrud cing*/ thugs rdo rje'i sa bon 'jog pa gsum pa shes rab ye shes/ 'jig rten pa'i dbang bzhi pa'i mthar thug gi bar ro// de nas phug bzhir gshegs nas seng ge'i khrid/ mngon par byang chub che la mnyam gzhag pas/ bsam gtan bzhir bzhugs g.yu mtsho lha mo'i glus/ dga' yo la der 'bras bu'i ston par bzhengs/ de yang*/ phug bzhi'i nang du ngal bso ba dang*/ khri bzhi la 'dug pa dang*/ pho brang g.yu mtsho 'khor ba'i glus dga' yo lar skal bzang su byed pa ni/ so so rang rig pas mngon par byang chub par dbugs phyung ba dang*/ zhu ba de'i mtshan nyid can rgyu'i he ru ka sgra bo bral gyi bsam gtan bzhir zhu dngas ma ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma bzhi'i glus bskul ba/ 'bras bu'i he ru ka kha sbyor gyi sku bzhi pa'i thig le/ spang bya 'pho ba'i skabs skyed pa thun mong rnam shes kyi chos 'khrud cing ye shes kyi rdo rje'i nus pa bzhag pa 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dbang bzhi pa'o// gang du bag yod dam tshig spyod pa'i 'gongs/ 'bum sder bskyod pas ma chen lung brgal nas/ mtha' yas skye dgu'i phan bde'i gzhi yin pa'i/ grags pa'i gter chen skyong bar bya ba yin// de nas gom pa shugs drag pos mkha' 'gro (20ba40)'bum sder bgrod cing*/

ma chen gyi la brgal ba'i bar ni/ dbang bskur ba thob nas/ zung 'jug dam tshig chen po'i spyod pa'i gom pas rtsa'i zhing khams 'bum sder 'ja' tshon du sbyangs pas/ rig ma'i skyes bu'am/ sangs rgyas sam kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan du grub pas thams cad du seng ge'i sgra sgrogs pa'i brda'o// 'ga' la dang po de de btags pa tsam/ zhes pa ni rim gyis pa'i gang zag la bskor ba dang po de/ dbang rgyu rkyen tshogs pa'i dmigs pa tsam du 'gyur bas/ mthong ba yang ri mtsho sogs ci rigs par ro// bar ma byin rlabs brnyan po tsam zhig ste/ zhes pa/ bar ma bskor bas mos pas smin pa ste/ thams cad kyang sgyu ma 'am gzugs brnyan tsam du mthong bar 'gyur ro// mtha' ma thams cad lta ru yongs rdzogs pas/ zhes pas/ lan gsum pa nang sprul pa'i lha zhal ji lta ba mthong zhing*/ des smin pa mtshan nyid par 'gyur te/ theg chen gyi lam thob pa zhes bya la/ rgyal dbang rjes/ rab dang mchog rab la ni dngos nyid dang*/ 'bring po rnams la gzugs brnyan snang ba tsam/ mtha' ma la yang mtsho dang brag phyir/ lan gsum gyis 'di 'khor zhes 'gro la bsnyad ces so// de yang*/ rdza dgon pa'i ri pa gsum gyis tsa ri gnas nang du/ gcig gis lo gsum bsdad/ gcig gis lo gnyis bsdad/ gcig gis lo gcig las ma sdad/ snga ma gnyis kyis g.yu mtsho ma 'khor/ phyi mas 'khor/ khong gsum bsdebs nas grum mdar btsong mo la chang nyos/ lo song ba'i gral rim du bsdad pas/ btsod mo na re/ khyed gsum gral mgo mjug log 'dug pas bza' ga na rnyed zer/ khong gnyis lo gsum dang (21 na 41)gnyis lon/ ngas gcig las ma lon/ gral ma log byas pas/ khong gnyis kyis g.yu mtsho ma 'khor khyod kyis 'khor 'dug pa zer/ de mkha' 'gro mar ngo shes bskor bas dag sna legs par byung*/ de bzhin 'dan ma pa zhig gis kyang lo gsum yul stod du bsdad/ g.yu mtsho 'khor bar dbus la 'gro bar chas rib pa lar sleb tsa na/

rgyab nas 'then 'then pa gsum byung*/ phyi bltas byas pas/ bu mo gzhon nu ma smar se khyug ge ba yod pa zhig 'dug pa na re khyod gar 'gro/ ri thos pa 'khor ba zer/ lo gsum song 'khor zin byas pas/ pho brang g.yu mtsho ma 'khor/ dngos grub ma thob par ma 'gro zer te yal song*/ mkha' 'gro mar shes nas g.yu mtsho bskor/ lo bzhugs byas pa'i dang po'i lo la/ pho brang la mchod rten brgya rtsas bskor bar mthong*/ gnyis pa la lha khang*/ gsum pa la sprul pa'i lha tshogs 'ga' mthong*/ sgom chen dga' mo zhig byung ba yin no// 'ga' zhig gis/ gal te gnas chen yin na yang*/ yul der 'gro ba'i gang zag ni/ dbang bskur thob cing dam tshig ldan/ brda dang brda yi lan shes shing*/ rim gnyis rtogs pa brtan pa yis/ spyod pa'i don du rgyu bar gsungs/ de lta min pa'i gang zag gis/ yul der 'gro brgyud las bkag /ces dang*/ gal te gsang sngags mi sgom zhing*/ rtogs pa yod par rlom pa yis/ yul der phyin na bar chad 'byung*/ ci yang med pa'i sgom chen gyis/ phyin kyang phan gnod gang yang med/ zer ba rang tshig nang 'gal te/ spyod pa ran pa las gzhan pa'i gang zag gis 'gro brgyud las bkag na/ gzhan der phyin na phan gnod med rab shad pa gar 'thad/ bde gshegs bka' 'das dngos sam/ nye bar 'byung bas so// rgyud las bkag ces smra ba yang 'chal ba ste/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi dri med 'od du/ de ltar mkha' 'gro ma'i dra ba sdom pa gnyis (21ba42)'gyur ni 'jig rten pa'i yul gyi tha snyad kyis byis pa'i skye bo rnams bsgral ba'i slad du gsungs so zhes 'byung ba dang*/ yang*/ 'dir thun mong du byis pa rnams yul du khyam pa'i don du dzā landha ra la sogs pa'i gnas rnams gsungs shing*/ zhes 'byung la/ khyam pa zhes pa yang*/ nā ro 'grel chen du/ spyir btang du/ byis pa rnams kyis bskor ba'i don du dzā landha ra la sogs pa'i gnas gsungs pa zhes 'byung bas so// 'di bskor ba ni sdig sgrib sbyong ba'i thabs mchog yin pa dang*/

'dir gsang sngags kyi lha tshogs la dmigs te/ gtor ma/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo phul bas/ lha de dag mnyes/ bsod nams kyi tshogs rdzogs pa yin la/ de la rnam par mi rtog pa ngo mtshar po rnyed pas/ bsod nams ye shes tshogs rab bsag /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rab mnyes byas/ chos la mi rtog ye shes ni/ skye phyir de ni dam par 'dod// ces/ tshul des ye shes kyi tshogs rdzogs la sgrib gnyis sbyong*/ tshogs gnyis gsog pa las lhag pa'i sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i thabs gar yang med do// de bas na/ slob dpon ārya de was sems kyi sgrib sbyong du/ de phyir bsam pa'i rtsa ba la/ bsod nams sdig pa rnam par gnas/ zhes gsungs pa yin pas/ rang gis rang mi bsru ba legs par 'dod pa dag gis gnas 'di bskor ba dang*/ 'di la mchod pa dang*/ 'dir gnas pa dag kyang dge ba'i bshes gnyen nyid du blta ste/ rang gi lus srog khyad du bsad nas/ skye dgu thams cad kyi ched du phan bde bsgrub pas byang chub sems dpa' 'ba' zhig go// zhes shes par byas nas/ bkur sti rim gros mnyes par bya ste/ de byas na/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu byi dor byas te/ rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo la btags par mchod pa bzhin/ gang 'dod pa'i don thams cad bde blag tu 'grub pa yin no zhes gdams so// de skad rdo rje 'chang gis gsang ba byin/ dkar brgyud bla ma'i tsha bo des smras tshe/ ḍā kī'i zhal gyi padmo (22 na 43)lo lo'i 'dzum/ ma lus bdag la thod bzhin 'ching bar mdzad/ ces/ tsa ri tra bskor ba yang*/ gsang chen gyi lam rim par bgrod pa'i brdar mthong ba ltar/ gzhan la sbyin pa'i chos su rgyas par bsnyad pa/ pad dkar legs bshad ces bya ba/ cig car dpal gyi nags ljongs/ rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po rnams mngon par dga' ba'i gzhal med khang du sbyar ba'i yi ge nyung ngu*/ slar rnam par phye ba byar phun tshogs rab brtan du bgyis pa 'jig rten thams cad du bde legs su gyur cig// /rgyal ba 'gro ba'i chos dor gzugs ci yang*/

de phyir mkhas pa don ldan de mi dgag /'dir zhen che la de smad gzhan gong 'don// bdag nyid che lugs de la bdag kyang gus// rang lugs ba tshwa'i chu yang yan lag brgyad// sgrub rlom gzhan tshig dag pa gaṅgā'i rgyun// rnyog chos sbyin rgya che spel ba'i ched// bar bzhengs glegs bu re re la// dngul krang yon 'gyed mdzad po ni// chos rgyal bsod nams rgyal mtshan no/// /
